profile.about: Software engineer building AI products. Write a few lines about your background, what you work on and what you know well.
profile.voice: Insightful and plain-spoken, first person, like talking to a smart friend. No buzzwords, no emojis.
profile.audience: Founders, engineers and tech hiring managers
profile.formatting: Strong first-line hook, a short story or concrete insight, one clear takeaway, end with a question. 120-220 words, short paragraphs.
profile.hashtags: 2-3 relevant hashtags on the last line
profile.avoid: Clickbait, 'I'm thrilled to announce', made-up statistics, hype
